sections.title: What goes where
sections.lede: Bogotá does not have a single bin for electronics.
paragraphs: If it uses power or a battery, it is WEEE (RAEE). It is handed in through different take-back programs — sometimes two kiosks in the same mall.
Mixing a computer with loose batteries, or leaving it in the building recycling bin, is the wrong circuit.

items.text: Phone, charger, cables, headphones → Ecolecta (SuperCADE or mall: Titán, Hayuelos, Unilago…).
Desktop or laptop → EcoCómputo. Not the Ecolecta kiosk, even in the same mall.
Loose cell or battery → Pilas con el Ambiente.
TV or small appliance → sometimes Red Verde (Homecenter, Alkosto).

sections.title: Not the trash, not the corner bin
sections.lede: Building recycling does not take WEEE.
paragraphs: In Bogotá they go to take-back points, not household trash or the corner recycling bin. That circuit is not built for electronics.

items.text: If you don’t know what it is, take a photo on Home.
The map only lists points that take that type.
Don’t leave it on the street or at a CADE that doesn’t take it.

sections.title: Cells and batteries
sections.lede: They go to Pilas con el Ambiente, not Ecolecta.
paragraphs: Button cells, rechargeables, and laptop or phone batteries are collected separately. Hayuelos, Titán, or SuperCADE CAD may have both Ecolecta and Pilas: two different kiosks.

items.text: Don’t throw them in the trash or the toilet.
Don’t puncture, open, or burn them.
If it’s swollen, isolate it and take it to a battery point without charging it.

sections.title: Damaged devices
sections.lede: Swollen, wet, or leaking devices are not for donation or further use.
paragraphs: A wet device or a swollen battery can catch fire if you charge or puncture it. In the app sheet you mark those conditions and the advice changes. The drop-off is still a Bogotá point that takes that waste.

items.text: Don’t use it, donate it, or charge it.
Store it isolated, away from heat, and take it to a point that accepts it.
Don’t leave it on the street or in a kiosk for a different program.
